LLRF.description: Live Load Reduction Factor (LLRF). Fields are driven by the reduction calculation rule (CALC_RULE): the RANGE_MAX/RANGE_MIN per-story bounds apply only when CALC_RULE is 0.

CALC_RULE.description: Calculation Rule. 0 = user-defined reduction range (Rmax/Rmin per story); 1 = code-based calculation. Must be 0 or 1.

APPLIED_COMP.description: Applied Components: force components the live load reduction is applied to. Enum values are case-insensitive.

LIVE_LOAD_CASES.description: Live Load Case Names. Each name must reference an existing static load case; at most 5 cases are used.

REDUCTION_DATA.description: Reduction Data Table: per-story reduction definition rows.

STORY.description: Story name. Must reference an existing story.

XMIN.description: X Min: lower X-range bound for the story.

XMAX.description: X Max: upper X-range bound for the story.

YMIN.description: Y Min: lower Y-range bound for the story.

YMAX.description: Y Max: upper Y-range bound for the story.

RANGE_MAX.description: [CALC_RULE=0] Max reduction factor (Rmax). Applied only when CALC_RULE is 0; must be one of 1, 0.95, 0.9, 0.85, 0.8, 0.75, 0.7, 0.65, 0.6, 0.55, 0.5 and be >= RANGE_MIN. Defaults to 1.0.

RANGE_MIN.description: [CALC_RULE=0] Min reduction factor (Rmin). Applied only when CALC_RULE is 0; must be one of 1, 0.95, 0.9, 0.85, 0.8, 0.75, 0.7, 0.65, 0.6, 0.55, 0.5 and be <= RANGE_MAX. Defaults to 0.5.
